name: Wuxi DK Electronic Materials Co.,Ltd.
summary: Wuxi DK Electronic Materials Co.,Ltd., an electronic materials company, engages in the research and development, production, and sale of conductive pastes for solar photovoltaic, display, lighting, and semiconductor fields in China. Its solution includes photovoltaic cell metallization, photovoltaic module interconnection, LED/IC chip packaging, third generation semiconductor chip packaging, and semiconductor ceramic copper clad laminate solutions. The company offers metallization conductive silver paste interconnect and conductive silver paste products. The company was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in Wuxi, China.
